name: brisa
description: Recopilador y gestor de ports nativos de PC al estilo EmuDeck, basado en manifiestos.
author: Kanin

scripts.serve: npm run build; concurrently -k -n build,web,server "tsc -p tsconfig.json --watch --preserveWatchOutput" "node scripts/copy-web.js --watch" "nodemon"
scripts.package:linux: npm run build && node scripts/build-desktop.mjs --only linux
scripts.package:windows: npm run build && node scripts/build-desktop.mjs --only windows
scripts.test: tsx --test test/glob.test.ts test/version.test.ts test/hash.test.ts test/preserve.test.ts test/tasks.test.ts test/config.test.ts test/cache.test.ts test/manifest.test.ts test/output.test.ts test/status.test.ts
